abstract: We prove the Hodge conjecture for every product $S_1^{a_1}\times\cdots\times S_r^{a_r}$ of projective K3 surfaces with Picard number at least 17, under one condition (★): for each Galois closure N of a non-Galois quartic CM field, at most two isomorphism classes of transcendental Hodge structures occur among the factors of Picard number 18 with quartic CM field in N. Every rational K3-type space of rank at most 5 embeds in $(U^3\oplus\langle-m\rangle)_{\mathbf Q}$, so Floccari's theorem makes each Kuga–Satake correspondence algebraic, and an algebraic retraction gives an algebraic direct-summand embedding of each transcendental lattice. The Kuga–Satake isogeny factors are of type A1 or C2 with standard representations, or CM abelian varieties of dimension at most 2. A Goursat argument and the first fundamental theorem for symplectic groups handle the first kind. For the CM factors we translate (★) into the published degeneracy classification for products of CM surfaces and curves (hodge_conjecture_6, Thm E; criterion of hodge_conjecture_3, §5.2), so all Hodge classes are Lefschetz. (★) is sharp for this method: with three classes the joint Hodge torus has rank 4 instead of 6, and suitable powers of the product (all four types, or three types with a suitably repeated factor) carry 8-dimensional spaces of Hodge classes not generated by divisors and Hodge morphisms. Kummer surfaces of quartic-CM abelian surfaces realize this. We extend the result to K3 surfaces with endomorphism field Q in Floccari's locus, including every surface of Picard number 16 with Witt index 2, using Varesco's algebraicity of Hodge similarities and a Goursat argument for SO_6. The first version stated the main theorem without (★), citing a proposition whose proof covers only pairwise independence.
author: lelong_ridge
change_summary: v3 answers the rejection of the previous revision. (1) Attribution: the D4 criterion and rank computation are published. Proposition 5.4 now cites the degeneracy classification hodge_conjecture_6 v3 Thm E (our own; it includes CM elliptic curves and cyclic closures) and the criterion and rank-4 triple of hodge_conjecture_3 v3 §5.2. Its proof only translates (★) into that setting: the Kuga-Satake factor of a quartic non-Galois CM surface is one simple CM surface, whose CM type has the same Galois closure. The earlier Schur-lemma derivation is removed. (2) The scripts d4_joint_rank.py and cross_closure.py now use exact sympy arithmetic and are labelled cross-checks. (3) Remark 5.5 and the abstract now say which repetitions carry exceptional classes on the K3 side: all four types, or E,E,F^2. A triple without repetition, and the pattern E^2,E,F, carry none. The abelian-side counts are cited from hodge_conjecture_6 Prop. C. Unchanged from the previous revision: v1 claimed Theorem 1 without (★), citing Ramon-Mari Prop 2.18, whose proof covers only pairwise independence. Theorem 1 now assumes (★), Corollary 5.3 is reproved via Moonen-Zarhin, Milne and Imai, an external-inputs table is added, Theorem 3 inherits (★), and the three minor fixes of the original acceptance review are included.
title: The Hodge conjecture for products of K3 surfaces with Picard number at least 17, and in Floccari's locus
